data.question: What documented ties connect Brett Leatherman to Trump, WEF, corruption allegations or public scandal?
data.method: Primary-source review, specialist-media corroboration, court-opinion review, official WEF document review and allegation classification.
findings: Leatherman is the assistant director and head of the FBI Cyber Division.
FBI Director Kash Patel selected or elevated Leatherman in June 2025.
Leatherman implements and explains the Trump administration's cyber strategy, including Operation Riptide.
The evidence establishes an institutional Trump tie, not a personal political affiliation or private Trump relationship.
The FBI is listed by WEF as a Partnership against Cybercrime member organization.
FBI Cyber Division experts participated in WEF's 2020 Partnership against Cybercrime study.
The 2020 report names Steven Kelly and Mike Shanahan as the FBI contributors; Leatherman is not named.
No credible adjudicated finding of corruption or misconduct by Leatherman was located.
A plaintiff-controlled site reports pending allegations and labels them unproven; the matter remains an unverified lead.
A policy controversy exists around FBI Cyber expanding public-facing defense work normally associated with CISA, but this is institutional context rather than evidence of corruption.
conclusions: Retain the verified institutional WEF path in the WEF dataset.
Do not label Leatherman personally as a WEF member, contributor, adviser or attendee.
Tag the Trump link as appointment-chain and policy-implementation.
Store Lacroix v. Leatherman only as disputed and unverified.
No substantiated personal-corruption finding was identified.
counterarguments: Undisclosed contact is possible, but institutional membership does not establish personal WEF affiliation.
Failure to locate an adjudicated finding does not prove no sealed or non-public matter exists.
limitations: No sealed records, non-public personnel files, private WEF attendee lists or undisclosed meetings.
The Lacroix matter was not treated as verified beyond the plaintiff's public description and docket reference.
unresolved: Retrieve and classify the full public docket and court orders.
Search DOJ OIG, OSC, GAO and congressional records for any later oversight findings.

workflow.next_action: Optional docket and oversight follow-up; WEF recursion completed.
